prompt:

Composition: A climbing instructor checks a student's securely fastened harness before allowing them to touch the climbing wall, showing a required condition that must come first.

Style: Use references/invidious.png for style only: thick rounded dark-brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D shapes, restrained cartoon shading.

Framing: One compact composition filling 80–90% of the square; keep all subjects complete. No decorative frame, pedestal, or floating ornaments.

Output: 512×512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and gaps. No text, letters, numerals, speech bubbles, labels, branding, or watermark.
Style reference invidious.png only: friendly rounded 2D cartoon, thick dark-brown outlines, flat colors, restrained shading. A climbing student checks their secure harness with an instructor before beginning a climb, showing necessary preparation beforehand.
en: A secure harness is a prerequisite for the climb.
ja: 安全なハーネスの装着は、登る前に必要な準備です。
